title: Status bar hover label

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Text-on-hover mode must enable hover polling, while icon-only and icon-and-text modes must not keep hover polling active.
A hover enter event must show the synthetic status title and a hover leave event must hide it again.
Hover reveal behavior must not mutate the saved menu-bar label display preference.

targetSurface: CodexPill status item runtime fake hover events and validation snapshots

nonClaims: Does not exercise native mouse movement or real pointer bounds.
Does not prove native hover activation or exit timer cadence.
Does not prove live macOS menu-bar screen capture or native hittability.
Does not prove multiple-display, notch, or menu-bar layout behavior.
